items.title: Splice's new AI DAW feels like a cheat code for music production
items.excerpt: Splice launches Create in beta: a free Mac DAW built around the Splice library with a voice-controlled AI chatbot, Rheo, that can teach you to make a track or assemble a full song from Splice samples and stock instruments.

items.title: Pro Tools now features AI stem separation
items.excerpt: Avid's Pro Tools 2026.11 adds an AI stem separation extension that splits any recording into up to six stems (vocals, drums, bass, guitar, keys, other) via drag-and-drop.
items.note: Release of the tool previewed at IBC (production-expert, published 09-15); stem separation hit 11-05 (Photon) - deprioritized slot
